title: Persistence of flatness after a flat stage
statement: Intermediate theorem used in the decomposition of lem-weil-pbc-colimit-flat-ring-map.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 02JO (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat, algebra.tex line 47331), part (3), applied to the system $(R_\lambda\to S_\lambda,M_\lambda)=(B_i\to C_i,C_i)_{i\ge0}$; this is the algebra result stated in the proof of Limits, Lemma Tag 04AI (lemma-descend-flat-finite-presentation, limits.tex line 1868), second paragraph

proof.text: For a later index i, put R = F(i₀), S = F(i₁), T = F(i). Functoriality makes R → S → T a scalar tower. Let ψ = id_S ⊗ φ₀. RingHom.Flat.lTensor base-changes the assumed flat map ψ to T ⊗[S] ψ. Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange identifies its domain and codomain with T ⊗[R] B₀ and T ⊗[R] C₀. The conjugated map agrees with id_T ⊗ φ₀ on the algebra generators 1 ⊗ b. Compose the flat base-change map with the two bijective ring maps using RingHom.Flat.of_bijective and RingHom.Flat.comp.

proof_origin.place: Direct Mathlib base change and tensor cancellation; no project lemma or new hole.
